# Inventory Management System

A Python-based Inventory Management System developed using Flask and SQLite.

## Features

- Add products
- Manage stock
- Stock In
- Stock Out
- Track product quantity
- Product units: Piece, Kg, Gram, Liter, Box
- SQLite database
- Excel reporting
- Web-based interface

## Technologies

- Python
- Flask
- SQLite
- Pandas
- OpenPyXL
- HTML
- CSS

## How to Run

Install the required packages:

```bash
pip install -r requirements.txt
python app.py
http://127.0.0.1:5000
